print(f"e_shoff={e_shoff}, e_shnum={e_shnum}, e_shstrndx={e_shstrndx}")
# Parse section headers
for i in range(e_shnum):

    sh_name, sh_type = struct.unpack('>II', data[off:off+8])
    sh_offset, sh_size = struct.unpack('>QQ', data[off+24:off+40])
    print(f"Section {i}: name_off={sh_name}, type=0x{sh_type:x}, offset={sh_offset}, size={sh_size}")
